scope: Stamp reaction rumors so receivers' last-writer-wins agrees with the sender's local view for remove→re-add and re-add→remove within one second.
files_to_modify: app/src/lib/reactions/api.ts (read helper returning the floor second for a triple from the store)
app/src/lib/directMessages.ts (publishDirectReaction/removeDirectReaction: accept and pass the floor if they are used by a send path)

behavior.add_floor: Re-add of a triple whose stored row has removedAt: notBeforeSec = floor(removedAt/1000) + 1.
behavior.remove_floor: Removal of a live triple: notBeforeSec = floor(row.createdAt/1000) (tie goes to the removal on every store).
behavior.no_row: No stored row for the triple: no floor (unchanged).
behavior.single_build: The rumor is still built exactly once (optimistic row id == published id); the floor is read before building.
behavior.optimistic_consistency: The optimistic row's createdAt should match the rumor's created_at*1000 where the code derives it, so the local and remote views agree.

tests: Unit rumor.ts: notBeforeSec in the future/past/absent
Unit api.ts floor helper: tombstone, live row, legacy tombstone (removal wins anyway: no floor needed or floor irrelevant), no row
Unit store convergence: a fresh peer store applying removal(S) then re-add(S+1) shows live; re-add(S+1) then removal(>=S+1) shows removed
